description.en:
Sell what's sitting inside your productions without loading a trailer and driving it across the map.
- Open the vanilla Production menu, select a production you own, then press F6 ("Production Direct Selling"). - Only shows products the production actually has in storage right now - nothing at 0L, nothing it merely could make. - Every sell point that accepts the selected product is listed, sorted highest price to lowest, using the game's real, live selling prices (market prices, seasonal swings, sell-point-specific prices - all vanilla). - Sell everything in one click or type a custom amount. - A random 2-18% remote-delivery fee applies to every sale (this is instant remote selling, so it costs a little more than driving it there yourself). The fee is rolled once per product/sell-point choice and stays put until you change something. - Always shows gross value, the fee, and your final payout before you confirm. Nothing is sold without your confirmation. - Full multiplayer support: the server validates the production, the sell point and the amount, and pays the correct farm.
This is a manual tool only - it never sells anything on its own.
